project.name: WorkLog
project.productType: Freelancer work log and productivity app

design.colorMode: light website; light and dark app

motion.style: subtle purposeful transitions; honor reduced motion

must: Preserve WorkLog's blue/navy identity and supplied logo
Use responsive, keyboard-accessible native Astro components
Keep account sign-up and login in the Android app; website verifies email and shares invoices
Use free dependencies and respect prefers-reduced-motion
avoid: Invented pricing or a fake APK download

decisions.choice: Use Poppins throughout the app and public website while preserving the WorkLog navy/blue palette.
Use Poppins across the app and public website; keep bundled font files for app rendering and self-host fonts on the website.
decisions.source: User-provided auth mockups and font files
